title: पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 15 · The sages stop the weapons

summary.en: Vyasa and Narada ask the two warriors to withdraw their weapons, and Arjuna does so, but Ashvatthaman cannot. He directs his weapon into the wombs of the Pandava women, and Vyasa asks him to give the jewel from his head.
summary.kn: ಅಸ್ತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಹಿಂತೆಗೆಯಲು ವ್ಯಾಸ, ನಾರದರು ಇಬ್ಬರು ವೀರರಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಅರ್ಜುನ ಹಿಂತೆಗೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಅಶ್ವತ್ಥಾಮನಿಗೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ. ಅವನು ಅಸ್ತ್ರವನ್ನು ಪಾಂಡವ ಸ್ತ್ರೀಯರ ಗರ್ಭದತ್ತ ತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ತಲೆಯ ಮಣಿ ಕೊಡಲು ವ್ಯಾಸ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: व्यास और नारद दोनों योद्धाओं से अस्त्र लौटाने को कहते हैं, अर्जुन लौटा लेते हैं पर अश्वत्थामा नहीं लौटा पाता। वह अस्त्र को पाण्डव स्त्रियों के गर्भों की ओर मोड़ देता है और व्यास उससे मस्तक की मणि देने को कहते हैं।
summary.te: అస్త్రాలను ఉపసంహరించమని వ్యాస, నారదులు ఇద్దరు వీరులను కోరతారు; అర్జునుడు ఉపసంహరిస్తాడు, అశ్వత్థామ చేయలేడు. అతడు అస్త్రాన్ని పాండవ స్త్రీల గర్భాల వైపు మళ్లిస్తాడు; తల మణి ఇవ్వమని వ్యాసుడు అంటాడు.
summary.ta: அஸ்திரங்களை விலக்கும்படி வியாசரும் நாரதரும் இரு வீரரையும் கேட்க, அர்ஜுனன் விலக்குகிறான், அஸ்வத்தாமனால் இயலவில்லை. அவன் அஸ்திரத்தைப் பாண்டவப் பெண்களின் கருவை நோக்கித் திருப்ப, தலை மணியைத் தரும்படி வியாசர் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: ആയുധങ്ങൾ പിൻവലിക്കാൻ വ്യാസനും നാരദനും ഇരുവീരന്മാരോടും ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു; അർജുനൻ അതനുസരിക്കുന്നു, എന്നാൽ അശ്വത്ഥാമാവിന് കഴിയുന്നില്ല. പാണ്ഡവസ്ത്രീകളുടെ ഗർഭത്തിലേക്ക് അദ്ദേഹം തന്റെ അസ്ത്രം തിരിക്കുന്നു; തലയിലെ രത്നം നൽകാൻ വ്യാസൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തോട് ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 10.15; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Fri Oct 30 2026

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वैव नरशार्दूलस्तावग्निसमतेजसौ ।
संजहार शरं दिव्यं त्वरमाणो धनंजयः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing those two of fiery radiance, Dhananjaya, the tiger among men, hastily withdrew his divine arrow.

verses.text:
उवाच वदतां श्रेष्ठस्तावृषी प्राञ्जलिस्तदा ।
प्रयुक्तमस्त्रमस्त्रेण शाम्यतामिति वै मया ॥

meaning.en: The best of speakers, with joined palms, said to the two sages: "I released this weapon so that weapon might be calmed by weapon.

verses.text:
संहृते परमास्त्रेऽस्मिन्सर्वानस्मानशेषतः ।
पापकर्मा ध्रुवं द्रौणिः प्रधक्ष्यत्यस्त्रतेजसा ॥

meaning.en: When this supreme weapon is withdrawn, the sinful Drona's son will surely burn us all entirely with the force of his weapon.

verses.text:
अत्र यद्धितमस्माकं लोकानां चैव सर्वथा ।
भवन्तौ देवसंकाशौ तथा संहर्तुमर्हतः ॥

meaning.en: In this matter, do what is best for us and for the worlds in every way; you two, who are like gods, are fit to withdraw it."

verses.text:
इत्युक्त्वा संजहारास्त्रं पुनरेव धनंजयः ।
संहारो दुष्करस्तस्य देवैरपि हि संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, Dhananjaya withdrew the weapon again; but even for gods its withdrawal in battle is hard.

verses.text:
विसृष्टस्य रणे तस्य परमास्त्रस्य संग्रहे ।
न शक्तः पाण्डवादन्यः साक्षादपि शतक्रतुः ॥

meaning.en: When that supreme weapon has been released in battle, no one but a Pandava is able to take it back, not even Shatakratu in person.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मतेजोभवं तद्धि विसृष्टमकृतात्मना ।
न शक्यमावर्तयितुं ब्रह्मचारिव्रतादृते ॥

meaning.en: For it is born of the energy of Brahma, and when released by one without self-mastery it cannot be turned back except by one who keeps the vow of celibacy.

verses.text:
अचीर्णब्रह्मचर्यो यः सृष्ट्वावर्तयते पुनः ।
तदस्त्रं सानुबन्धस्य मूर्धानं तस्य कृन्तति ॥

meaning.en: One who has not practiced celibacy and who releases it and calls it back, that weapon cuts off the head of him and his kin.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मचारी व्रती चापि दुरवापमवाप्य तत् ।
परमव्यसनार्तोऽपि नार्जुनोऽस्त्रं व्यमुञ्चत ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna, celibate and keeping his vows, who had obtained that hard-to-gain weapon, did not release it even in the deepest distress.

verses.text:
सत्यव्रतधरः शूरो ब्रह्मचारी च पाण्डवः ।
गुरुवर्ती च तेनास्त्रं संजहारार्जुनः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: The Pandava, hero, holding to truth and celibate, obedient to his teacher, thereby withdrew the weapon.

verses.text:
द्रौणिरप्यथ संप्रेक्ष्य तावृषी पुरतः स्थितौ ।
न शशाक पुनर्घोरमस्त्रं संहर्तुमाहवे ॥

meaning.en: Drona's son also, seeing the two sages standing before him, could not withdraw that terrible weapon in battle.

verses.text:
अशक्तः प्रतिसंहारे परमास्त्रस्य संयुगे ।
द्रौणिर्दीनमना राजन्द्वैपायनमभाषत ॥

meaning.en: Unable to withdraw the supreme weapon, Drona's son, dejected, said to Dvaipayana, O king:

verses.text:
उत्तमव्यसनार्तेन प्राणत्राणमभीप्सुना ।
मयैतदस्त्रमुत्सृष्टं भीमसेनभयान्मुने ॥

meaning.en: "Sage, I released this weapon, afflicted by the worst misfortune and seeking to save my life, out of fear of Bhimasena.

verses.text:
अधर्मश्च कृतोऽनेन धार्तराष्ट्रं जिघांसता ।
मिथ्याचारेण भगवन्भीमसेनेन संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: And in the fight Bhimasena, lord, by deceitful conduct, did unrighteousness in trying to kill the Dhartarashtra.

verses.text:
अतः सृष्टमिदं ब्रह्मन्मयास्त्रमकृतात्मना ।
तस्य भूयोऽद्य संहारं कर्तुं नाहमिहोत्सहे ॥

meaning.en: Therefore, brahmin, I released this weapon with an unsteady mind, and now I cannot bring myself to call it back.

verses.text:
विसृष्टं हि मया दिव्यमेतदस्त्रं दुरासदम् ।
अपाण्डवायेति मुने वह्नितेजोऽनुमन्त्र्य वै ॥

meaning.en: I released this divine, irresistible weapon, sage, after invoking the fire's energy with the words, 'Let there be no Pandavas.'

verses.text:
तदिदं पाण्डवेयानामन्तकायाभिसंहितम् ।
अद्य पाण्डुसुतान्सर्वाञ्जीविताद्भ्रंशयिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Aimed at the death of the Pandavas, it will today make all the sons of Pandu lose their lives.

verses.text:
कृतं पापमिदं ब्रह्मन्रोषाविष्टेन चेतसा ।
वधमाशास्य पार्थानां मयास्त्रं सृजता रणे ॥

meaning.en: This sin has been done, brahmin, with a mind seized by rage, in releasing the weapon in battle with the hope of killing the Parthas."

verses.text: व्यास उवाच

meaning.en: Vyasa said:

verses.text:
अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरस्तात विद्वान्पार्थो धनंजयः ।
उत्सृष्टवान्न रोषेण न वधाय तवाहवे ॥

meaning.en: Dear one, Partha Dhananjaya knew the Brahmashira weapon, but he released it in battle neither in anger nor for your death.

verses.text:
अस्त्रमस्त्रेण तु रणे तव संशमयिष्यता ।
विसृष्टमर्जुनेनेदं पुनश्च प्रतिसंहृतम् ॥

meaning.en: He released it only to quell your weapon with a weapon, and then took it back again.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मास्त्रमप्यवाप्यैतदुपदेशात्पितुस्तव ।
क्षत्रधर्मान्महाबाहुर्नाकम्पत धनंजयः ॥

meaning.en: Though he too obtained the Brahma weapon by your father's instruction, the mighty-armed Dhananjaya did not flinch from the warrior's duty.

verses.text:
एवं धृतिमतः साधोः सर्वास्त्रविदुषः सतः ।
सभ्रातृबन्धोः कस्मात्त्वं वधमस्य चिकीर्षसि ॥

meaning.en: Why do you wish to kill a steadfast, good man like this, who knows all weapons, along with his brothers and kin?

verses.text:
अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरो यत्र परमास्त्रेण वध्यते ।
समा द्वादश पर्जन्यस्तद्राष्ट्रं नाभिवर्षति ॥

meaning.en: In a kingdom where the Brahmashira weapon is struck down by another supreme weapon, the rain-cloud does not rain for twelve years.

verses.text:
एतदर्थं महाबाहुः शक्तिमानपि पाण्डवः ।
न विहन्त्येतदस्त्रं ते प्रजाहितचिकीर्षया ॥

meaning.en: For this reason the mighty-armed Pandava, though able, does not strike down this weapon of yours, wishing the good of the people.

verses.text:
पाण्डवास्त्वं च राष्ट्रं च सदा संरक्ष्यमेव नः ।
तस्मात्संहर दिव्यं त्वमस्त्रमेतन्महाभुज ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas, and you, and the kingdom should always be protected by us; therefore, mighty-armed one, withdraw this divine weapon.

verses.text:
अरोषस्तव चैवास्तु पार्थाः सन्तु निरामयाः ।
न ह्यधर्मेण राजर्षिः पाण्डवो जेतुमिच्छति ॥

meaning.en: Let there be no anger in you, and let the Parthas be unharmed; for the royal sage, the Pandava, does not wish to win by unrighteousness.

verses.text:
मणिं चैतं प्रयच्छैभ्यो यस्ते शिरसि तिष्ठति ।
एतदादाय ते प्राणान्प्रतिदास्यन्ति पाण्डवाः ॥

meaning.en: And give them the jewel that sits on your head; taking it, the Pandavas will give you back your life.

verses.text: द्रौणिरुवाच

meaning.en: Drona's son said:

verses.text:
पाण्डवैर्यानि रत्नानि यच्चान्यत्कौरवैर्धनम् ।
अवाप्तानीह तेभ्योऽयं मणिर्मम विशिष्यते ॥

meaning.en: Among all the gems that the Pandavas have won, and all the other wealth of the Kauravas, this jewel of mine surpasses them.

verses.text:
यमाबध्य भयं नास्ति शस्त्रव्याधिक्षुधाश्रयम् ।
देवेभ्यो दानवेभ्यो वा नागेभ्यो वा कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: Wearing it, there is no fear arising from weapons, disease or hunger, nor from gods, danavas or serpents in any way.

verses.text:
न च रक्षोगणभयं न तस्करभयं तथा ।
एवंवीर्यो मणिरयं न मे त्याज्यः कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: Nor is there fear of hosts of rakshasas, nor of thieves; such is the power of this jewel, and I must never part with it.

verses.text:
यत्तु मे भगवानाह तन्मे कार्यमनन्तरम् ।
अयं मणिरयं चाहमिषीका निपतिष्यति ।
गर्भेषु पाण्डवेयानाममोघं चैतदुद्यतम् ॥

meaning.en: But what the lord has told me I must do next: this jewel is here, and I am here, and this blade of grass will fall upon the wombs of the Pandava women; that which has been raised is unfailing.

verses.text: व्यास उवाच

meaning.en: Vyasa said:

verses.text:
एवं कुरु न चान्या ते बुद्धिः कार्या कदाचन ।
गर्भेषु पाण्डवेयानां विसृज्यैतदुपारम ॥

meaning.en: Do so, and do not ever let another thought arise in you; having released it into the wombs of the Pandavas, desist.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततः परममस्त्रं तदश्वत्थामा भृशातुरः ।
द्वैपायनवचः श्रुत्वा गर्भेषु प्रमुमोच ह ॥

meaning.en: Then Ashvatthaman, greatly distressed, having heard the words of Dvaipayana, released that supreme weapon into the wombs.
